pages.title: Stochastic Kinetics
pages.text: $(thing)Stochastic Kinetics$()$(br2)In a cell there may be ten molecules of something: reactions happen one at a time, at random moments. Gillespie simulated them exactly.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Statistics, Monte Carlo Methods, Markov Chains.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Microstate Tally.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Reactions fire at a total rate a. With a random number u between 0 and 1, write how long W to wait until the next one.
